# Bitcoin Midday Brief — June 17

Bitcoin holding steady at $66K—barely budging on the session. Volume's anemic, which tells you traders are sitting on their hands.

Here's what matters: Fear and Greed is deep in extreme fear territory at 22. That's capitulation pricing, historically the setup for reversals. But we're not seeing panic liquidations yet.

On-chain, the mempool's loaded with 127K transactions backing up. Fastest fees hit 4 sat/vB—cheap network conditions. That's smart accumulation
